 Nearly 100K ballots cast on first day of early voting in SC 
 By Michael Owens Published : Oct. 20, 2026 at 11:37 AM EDT | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google COLUMBIA, S.C. (WIS) - Nearly 100,000 ballots were cast Monday as South Carolina opened its early voting period. 
 Data from the South Carolina Election Commission shows 97,968 ballots were cast statewide. 
 Compared to other opening days of early voting, Monday’s number more than doubled the first-day numbers from the 2022 midterm election, but was slightly down from the 2024 presidential election. 
 Charleston and Greenville counties each saw the highest turnout in the state with over 9,000 ballots cast. 
 Richland, Horry, York, Spartanburg, Lexington, Aiken and Beaufort rounded out the top 10 counties in terms of first-day turnout.
 Other details, such as voter participation by party affiliation, are not made available in a general election. 
 South Carolina’s early voting period runs through Oct. 31. Click/tap here for more information.
